change: Persistent sandbox round and goal counters for both sides
behavior: Always-visible Round N, Your side goals, and Enemy goals above the battlefield.
Goals increment on recorded far-gate arrival during playback and accumulate across rounds. Both arena reset actions return to round one and zero goals.
Counts all marcher bodies, including monsters. Arrival credit uses the gate reached, preserving correct allegiance at arrival.
Duplicate arrival events and waiting pictures cannot score twice; later death or removal cannot erase an arrival.
The existing surviving-unit retirement and combat simulation are unchanged.

Both owners reach their actual far gate; the other side gains no goal.

Both reset actions clear the round, goals, and pending playback arrivals.
